statements.status_notes: Parsing an XML catalog whose nextCatalog element lacks its mandatory catalog attribute dereferenced a NULL entry in the nextCatalog de-duplication loop of xmlParseXMLCatalogNode() in catalog.c, crashing the application. That loop is part of Debian's backport of the CVE-2026-0992 fix, shipped in 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3, and Debian lists trixie as vulnerable: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-76781. Upstream fixed it by guarding the loop against a NULL entry: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/c63248941708bc1d2e3a4292954593312212f6ca (merge request https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/merge_requests/442; released in libxml2 2.15.4). The DHI Debian 13 libxml2 build of 2.1+deb13u3 that this range marks fixed, the only build of this source now in the DHI Debian repository, carries that one-line guard; its shipped changelog (/usr/share/doc/libxml2/changelog.Debian.gz in the libxml2 package, amd64 and arm64) records the backport for CVE-2026-76781. Earlier DHI builds of this source, no longer published, were built without the guard.
